title: unified-rollouts-canary-ab-shadow-autorollback-workflow-improvements
author: Priya Desai
description: Motivation: improve the unified rollouts workflow to support a combined canary + A/B weighted rollout with shadow probing and an automated, quorum-based rollback mechanism. This PR consolidates control-plane logic for staged rollouts, implements composite metric evaluation across latency/error/quality signals, introduces a probing stage for shadow traffic, and hardens rollback safety guards. Goals: (1) enable weighted A/B canaries with shadow probing to validate model variants against production traffic without impacting users, (2) implement quorum-based auto-rollback that requires metric consensus from multiple probes/regions before triggering rollback, (3) surface richer observability and telemetry for rollouts (per-variant SLOs, composite metric time series, telemetry-driven explanations), (4) add e2e and integration tests to prevent regressions. Related: ENG-1429 (unified rollouts roadmap), ENG-1501 (observability for rollouts), SUP-8421 (support case that motivated quorum semantics).
commits: Improve rollout controller: add weighted AB canary state machine and probe stage
Add composite-metric evaluator and quorum logic for auto-rollback
Expose per-variant rollout metrics to telemetry and tracing
Add e2e tests for canary -> probe -> promote/rollback scenarios
Docs: rollout strategy examples and migration notes
Fix: handle nil pointer in rollout finalizer when shadow config absent

review_comments: Ethan Cole: Overall this reads well and the state machine is clear. Two asks: (1) add a safety guard to limit rollback thrash in short windows, and (2) please document expected operator actions when a probe repeatedly times out.
Priya Desai (author): Added short-term cooldown guard to auto-rollback (configurable window and max rollbacks) and updated docs with operator guidance. See controller.go and strategies.md changes.
Mariana Ruiz: The composite metric looks right; can we make the metric weights configurable per-customer? Also suggest adding a dashboard snippet to the docs for quick debugging.
Priya Desai: Made weights configurable via RolloutSpec.CompositeMetric.Weights and added a Grafana dashboard snippet to docs. Left default weights matching current SLOs.
Samir Patel: CI failed on e2e in first run - failure looks flakey from environment. Re-run CI after making small test timing adjustments.
Priya Desai: Adjusted test fixtures to use deterministic clocks and reduced timing sensitivity. Re-ran CI - green.
release_notes: Enhancements: Weighted A/B canary rollout with shadow probing, quorum-based automated rollback, per-variant rollout telemetry, e2e tests and docs. Operator action notes and migration guidance added.
notes_for_ops:
- New CRD fields: probeConfig (probeIntervalMs, probeSamples), quorumConfig (minRegions, minSuccessFraction, cooldownWindowMs).
- Default behavior is backwards compatible; existing rollouts continue to operate.
- Recommended: upgrade telemetry dashboards to include rollout.variant.* metrics to monitor composite metric and probe success rates.
